rationale: Round 13's load-bearing change is that an untrusted base name is FOLDED wherever a reader note quotes it, because those notes are persisted into a failure_reason that is later replayed to a model verbatim. Removing the fold lets a base carrying U+2028/U+202E forge a line in that prose: the hostile-base test in the guard suite goes red, while the prover suite, which never composes a reader note, stays green.
